review: All nine images visually inspected; no regeneration.
face_evidence: Broader cheek plane, shorter lower face, wider eye spacing and smaller thin mouth distinguish Lunatone from Seviper; blunt ash-blond hair and straight fringe retain the chosen structure. Crescent rock contours were interpreted as human facial planes, not a beak.
forms: Light crescent plates; heavy broad overlapping crescent shells; mobility tapered separated fins and round vents. Each overdrive retains matching camera, pose and anatomy and opens existing seams with gold light and floating stones.

casuals.observed: Moonlit outdoor pool; cream red-trimmed cutout swimsuit, juice glass at pool coping.
casuals.deviations: Waist-level crop instead of chest-up; one hand submerged. Recorded as framing result.

casuals.observed: Full-body cream-gold satin lingerie at bedroom window; one hand draws curtain and other rests on bedside table.
casuals.deviations: Faces camera and stands rather than leaning on furniture; recorded.

casuals.observed: Terracotta crop sports top and cream leggings, both arms overhead in a triceps stretch on a mat at sunrise.
casuals.deviations: Tighter framing than environmental wide and raised elbow reaches top edge; one heel raised. Recorded per rule 6.

diversity: Compared with Seviper, Wurmple and Wormadam casual sets. Pool close composition, curtain-standing full figure and overhead exercise gesture are distinct in activity and clothing.
